a2ui: Agent-to-UI mini-apps, runtime defaults, MCP bridge, and debugger.
about: Version, build, diagnostics, updates and credits.
account: Your identity, plan usage, profile, subscription and paired devices in one place.
agentModes: Built-in and custom agent modes — system prompt, tool list, output format and live preview presets.
agentRuntime: Built-in Anthropic SDK sidecar — defaults, permission mode, always-allow tools, built-in tool categories, sidecar diagnostics, and the A2UI bridge.
agentTeams: Multi-agent team templates — manager-worker, parallel specialists, research squad. Browse built-ins, duplicate to fork, or create new templates.
agents: External agents — Claude Code CLI, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor and any custom command speaking ACP / OpenCode / HTTP.
aiConnections: Configure AI accounts, endpoints, credentials, deployments, verification, health, and import or export.
apiKey: Anthropic API key (used by the local sidecar).
appearance: Theme, font scale, language and motion.
artifacts: Auto-detect code, HTML, React, SVG, Mermaid, charts, math and Jupyter notebooks into a side-panel workspace.
automation: Desktop UI automation — screenshot, find element, click, type, send keys. Disabled by default; gated by a three-tier permission policy with a global kill switch.
canvas: Monaco-based code/document editor with AI actions, version history, inline suggestions, sandboxed execution and collaboration.
ccswitch: Reuse providers, MCP servers, prompts and skills from CCSwitch — switch the active subscription with one click.
characters: Reusable personas with their own model and skills.
companion: Mobile companion server — bind mode (loopback / LAN), QR pairing, paired devices, and revocation.
connections: Configure messaging platform adapters (Telegram, Discord, Slack, ...) and manage the outbound delivery queue.
conversation: Auto titles and the conversation timeline minimap
data: Export, import or wipe local IndexedDB data.
desktop: Tauri-only window, autostart and tray behavior.
diagnostics: Crash logs, recent errors, and native logging diagnostics with export bundles.
discover: Pin, reorder, or hide the Discover categories.
eval: Default judge model, scorers, quality gates, and cost guards for agent evaluations.
externalBridge: MCP server that exposes Cognia's wiki, RAG, and runtime entities to external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Cline). Opt-in per scope.
fleet: Monitor and control coding agents launched anywhere on this machine (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode), the Dynamic-Island overlay, and recent-session history.
gateway: Local OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoint that lets external tools (Claude Code, any OpenAI client) borrow your providers, routing, and credentials.
general: Default model, working directory, system prompt, permission mode and always-allowed tools.
goals: Persistent chat goals (ADR-0019). Set an objective with /goal and the agent auto-continues until a judge confirms it's done, or budgets / timeouts kick in.
hooks: Lifecycle hooks for ~/.claude/settings.json (User / Project / Local). 21 events × matcher × command-or-webhook handlers.
logs: Log levels, transports (console / IndexedDB / native / remote / Langfuse / OpenTelemetry), retention, redaction and per-module sampling.
lsp: Configure LSP language servers shared by the agent runtime and editor
mcp: Model Context Protocol servers (stdio / SSE / HTTP).
memory: Autonomous long-term memory — what the assistant remembers about you across sessions, plus extraction, recall, and privacy controls.
modelCatalog: Search canonical models, provider offerings, aliases, capabilities, lifecycle, and routed IDs.
network: HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS5 proxy for all outbound network traffic. Auto-detect Clash Verge, Mihomo, V2Ray and other local proxy tools.
notifications: Notification center channels, quiet hours, per-source mute, and retention.
ocr: OCR providers (Mistral OCR, Google Vision, AWS Textract, Azure DI, Claude / GPT / Gemini vision, Mathpix, OCR.space, ABBYY, Nanonets, Lark) plus on-device engines (Tesseract WASM/native, Windows.Media.Ocr, Apple Vision, Android ML Kit, ocrs, PaddleOCR) and the self-hosted HTTP adapter. Includes auto-router, PDF fast-path, and result cache.
plugins: Browse, install, configure, and govern plugins. Review permissions, scheduled jobs, devtools, and contract audits.
presets: Reusable session configurations — system prompt plus model, tool, MCP, and skill overrides.
proIde: Embedded VS Code install and disk usage
profile: Your local display name, avatar and bio — synced to companion devices and included in backups.
providers: AI provider API keys, models, and connection settings.
remoteControl: Local HTTP listener for inbound triggers, plus webhook signing and custom headers for outbound calls.
remoteHosts: Drive a remote Cognia host — its terminal, files, and git — from this desktop.
sandbox: OS / microVM sandbox health and tool execution policy
scheduledTasks: Configure cron-style automation, agent permissions, and resource limits
search: Web search providers (Tavily, Brave, Bing, Google, Perplexity, Exa…), defaults, cache, safety and source verification.
security: Biometric guards for sensitive actions and privacy controls
shellLayout: Reorder or hide items in the sidebar, the top bar and the bottom bar.
shortcuts: View and rebind every keyboard shortcut — global system hotkeys, in-app shortcuts, and editor keybindings — in one place, with conflict detection.
skills: Reusable instruction blobs appended to system prompts.
slashCommands: Built-in, custom, and plugin-contributed slash commands — browse, search, and copy a command into the composer.
sourceControl: AI commit-message generation and other Git panel preferences.
speech: Voice input (STT) language and microphone, plus read-aloud (TTS) provider, voice and auto-play.
subagents: Sub-agent templates and live runtime — spawn focused workers from a parent agent for research, code review, content, or analysis sub-tasks.
subscription: Sign in with your Claude, Codex (ChatGPT), or OpenCode subscription, monitor rate-limit windows and balances, and manage OAuth credentials in your OS keychain.
terminal: Integrated terminal dock — default shell, font, scrollback, and per-project overrides.
tools: Built-in shell, filesystem, git, process and environment tools — global on/off, risk levels, and always-allow management.
workflows: Visual n8n-style orchestration over characters, teams, skills, twins, and connectors. Trigger via cron, webhook, platform message, or manual run.
workspaceTrust: Trust folders before agents run commands in them. Untrusted workspaces run in Restricted Mode.
